facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list dated 2 February 2026 records Congo as having signed the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection on 12 June 2015.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)

facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list dated 2 February 2026 records Congo as having ratified or acceded to the Malabo Convention on 24 September 2020 and deposited the instrument on 23 October 2020.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)
